title: Draw Your Day in Five Icons
description: Sum up a normal day using only five simple icons, then explain them to a friend.
instructions: Take a piece of paper or open any drawing app.
Draw five simple icons that represent what you did today.
Show them to a friend and let them guess the story.
Take a photo or screenshot of your icons.
evidencePrompt: Which icon was hardest to choose, and what did that teach you about your day?
